checks.acceptance_registry: All three new Lean modules, the new control module and all 24 new independent wrappers are registered. The registry contains 82 unique public contract names and 66 rejection cases including the six special rejection cases. Inherited native producers and dependency pins are unchanged in the 13-file increment.
checks.actual_counterexamples: Positive controls bind actual floor prefixes, digits, shifted words, singleton counts and signed carries to the original certificates. The actual N=5 example has c_5=1, d_5=d_6=0 and T_5=0, refuting the two-zero trigger. Other controls distinguish omitted minus one, unchanged digits, shifted origins, lost width, unbounded involution, omitted count swap, reversed sign/direction, uncarried suffix size and one-way normality.
checks.actual_source: beta is the actual real number 1-alpha. The strict original dyadic lower bound is proved from the existing integer polynomial obstruction. The floor identity is valid at every natural exponent, including zero, and retains the essential minus one. Certificate transfer retains both the original certificate and q+r+1=2^N.
checks.claim_ledger_and_documentation: Thirteen new universal claim entries resolve to source declarations and claim IDs are unique. The formal complement sparsity item remains open for aggregate suffix or positive-carry counting and sufficient positive carries. README, agent-facing instructions, mathematical notes and literature gate distinguish proved finite groundwork, the already published stronger result, and the remaining formalization and normality obligations.
checks.counts_and_normality_equivalence: All-start overlapping block counts transfer at the same width and prefix length. Complementary ones equal original zeros, and complementary zeros equal original ones. Both directions of normality equivalence retain every block, tolerance, positive eventual threshold and later prefix. Neither normality proposition is proved.
checks.digit_sum_and_public_bound: The integer sum of actual complementary digits over range N equals its singleton one count, then equals the original singleton zero count. Contracts.complementCarryBounds uses this exact bridge to state -2<=carry(N)<original occurrences(2,1,0,N), including N=0.
checks.digits_and_fixed_width_blocks: Actual complementary digits equal 1-original_digit. Actual blocks equal 2^width-1-original_block, preserving start and width. The computed mapped power word is identified with the actual real-digit word, including length and leading zeros. Bounded flipValue involution and block matching explicitly require j<2^k.
checks.finite_convolution_and_residual: The actual prefix has the weighted digit reconstruction. The square decomposition q_N^2=2^N*C_N+U_N uses actual suffix blocks ending at N. U_N is nonnegative uncarried suffix convolution, not a Euclidean remainder. The boundary identity is 2^N*T_N=U_N-P_N, with 0<P_N<3*2^N. The explicit signed-sum formula is finite.
checks.negative_control_scope: Fifteen isolated rejection sources use source-bound finite contradictions or intended theorem-type mismatches. Their rejection patterns are configured to detect the relevant decide contradiction or type mismatch. Actual process return codes and diagnostics remain the responsibility of the separate acceptance gate.
checks.pointwise_carry_bounds: Nonnegative U_N and the strict residual upper bound imply T_N>=-2. The weighted suffix estimate U_N<=2^N*sum(d_i) and positive residual imply T_N<sum(d_i). These are pointwise statements and do not establish an aggregate carry estimate.
checks.positivity: Zero-digit propagation is backward from T_(N+1)>0 to T_N>0. The gap interval is start<=i<start+length; its upper digit endpoint is excluded. The positive-convolution trigger requires c_N>0 and all three digits d_N,d_(N+1),d_(N+2) to vanish.
checks.signed_polynomial_and_indices: The source polynomial is beta^2-3*beta+1=0. All residual, convolution and carry arithmetic is signed integer arithmetic. convolutionCoefficient N is the coefficient of fractional binary place N+1, and the exact recurrence is 2*T_N=T_(N+1)+a_N with a_N=c_N-3*d_N. The initial carry is -1.

limitations: This is a source audit, not an independent rerun of Lean, native producers, tests or the full acceptance gate.
A matching exact-revision acceptance packet must establish compilation, axiom closure, actual contract types, all positive controls and intended negative-control diagnostics.

No aggregate suffix estimate, sufficiently-many-positive-carries theorem, infinite-series convergence or identification theorem, or square-root bound for the original zero count is established by this increment.
The stronger complement sparsity result is known in the cited literature; the open item is its formalization here.
Normality, positive density and universal native refinement remain unproved.

literature.scope: The signed-coefficient argument and backward positivity in Sections 6-7 are distinguished from the positive-polynomial argument. The paper normalizes its algebraic number to (1,2); the current formal increment derives finite identities directly for the actual fractional beta in (0,1). No literature theorem is imported as a Lean axiom.

mechanical_acceptance: Not assessed by this source audit; requires the separate complete acceptance report for this exact source revision. Source inventories and intended negative-control diagnostics are not compiler execution results.
scope: Independent read-only mathematical, source-binding, public-contract, control-source, and documentation review of the binary complement and finite signed carry increment. All 67 non-evidence, non-vendor source inputs were reconciled byte-for-byte with the exact published Git commit. Only ignored review artifacts were written; no tracked file was changed.
